items.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Indian equities snapped a two-day winning streak on Friday as heavy selling in banking and financial stocks, elevated crude oil prices and lingering geopolitical uncertainties outweighed positive corporate earnings, pushing benchmark indices lower despite gains in select technology and automobile shares.

items.summary: Titan, part of the Tata Group, reported strong FY27 results, with June quarter net profit rising 63% YoY to ₹1,777 crore. Revenue from operations also surged 40% YoY to ₹20,787 crore.

items.title: ICICI Bank, Axis Bank tap dollar debt again in less than two months: Report
items.summary: ICICI Bank and Axis Bank have returned to the U.S. dollar debt market, each looking to raise $300 million through upcoming bond issues, set to close for subscription next week. Notably, last month saw ICICI Bank raise a substantial $1 billion while Axis Bank secured $800 million. This bond issuance utilizes the Reserve Bank of India's hedging facility to facilitate smoother transactions.

items.title: Titan Q1 Results: Profit soars 63% YoY to Rs 1,777 crore, total income surges 40%
items.summary: Titan Q1 Results: Consumer discretionary major Titan Ltd on Friday reported 63% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 1,777 crore in the first quarter, compared with Rs 1,091 crore in the last year quarter. Total income in the reporting period rose 40% YoY to Rs 20,753 crore.

items.summary: Solar stocks rose in premarket trading President Donald Trump announced fresh import restrictions on polysilicon products.

items.title: SBI sees broad-based credit growth, sticks to 14-15% FY27 loan growth guidance
items.summary: State Bank of India expects credit growth to remain broad-based across segments. The bank retained its loan growth guidance at fourteen to fifteen percent. It also anticipates mobilising around ten billion dollars in foreign-currency deposits. Net interest margin guidance remains at three percent for the financial year. Asset quality is not currently a concern due to El Nino conditions.

items.title: Hindalco Q1 results: Profit soars 75% YoY to record Rs 7,013 crore; revenue jumps 32%
items.summary: Hindalco Industries reported a record 75% year-on-year jump in June-quarter consolidated net profit to Rs 7,013 crore, driven by strong India aluminium and copper operations and a recovery at Novelis. Revenue rose 32% to an all-time high of Rs 84,825 crore, while EBITDA surged 73% to Rs 14,989 crore, reflecting robust operational performance despite exceptional expenses.

items.title: Won't ease ‘energy drink’ label 90-day deadline — FSSAI says companies should ‘be happy not prosecuting…’: Report
items.summary: In July, the FSSAI privately gave the companies 90 days to drop “energy drink” or any similar description from high-caffeine beverages, saying there were no Indian standards for such products and that using that term breached regulations.

items.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 7 August: Bajaj Finance, Navin Fluorine, Trent, Tata Capital, Swiggy among top losers
items.summary: The Indian stock market struggled on August 7, with the Nifty 50 down 0.32% and the Sensex declining 0.59%. Concerns over a potential peace deal in the Middle East and financial sector weaknesses led to mixed performance among broader markets and sector indices.

items.title: Rupee nudges up on-week; traders stay cautious as oil firms, US payrolls loom
items.summary: The Indian rupee maintained stability on Friday, showing a small improvement over the week. The central bank's intervention helped alleviate the impact of higher oil prices and market hesitance. Significant inflows from balance of payments strategies fortified the Reserve Bank of India’s defenses. Investors are now keenly awaiting essential U.S. labor market statistics, especially the non-farm payrolls data from the last month, for insights on future economic trends.

items.title: EXIM Bank to be implementing agency for interest subvention support for exporters: DGFT
items.summary: The commerce ministry announced EXIM Bank will implement export credit interest subvention. This transition from the Reserve Bank of India is effective April 1, 2026. EXIM Bank will manage all operational aspects and claim settlements. The Reserve Bank of India will process claims for the January to March 2026 quarter.

items.title: Centum Electronics to invest Rs 500 crore in Karnataka: MB Patil
items.summary: Centum Electronics will invest five hundred crore rupees in Karnataka. A new aerospace and defence electronics manufacturing facility will be built. Construction begins in September and will create fifteen hundred jobs. This facility will produce high-end radar and electronic warfare technologies. Karnataka is intensifying efforts to attract new manufacturing investments.

items.title: Hindalco rides aluminium supply shock, US unit Novelis' rebound in first quarter
items.summary: Hindalco Industries sees strong performance from rising aluminium prices and Novelis' recovery. Global aluminium prices increased significantly due to supply shocks and a widening deficit. Novelis, its US subsidiary, improved operations after restarting its Oswego hot mill. The company achieved substantial cost savings and targets further operational improvements. Hindalco's India aluminium business also benefited from higher realisations during the quarter.

items.summary: Akasa Air CEO Vinay Dube supports airport operators owning airlines, which IndiGo opposes. The airline is seeking significant funding amid rising operating costs. Akasa reported a substantial financial loss for the fiscal year 2025. The company plans fleet expansion with many aircraft on order. Akasa continues to grow its operations and employee base.

items.title: US strikes $1.2bn deal to pay German firm to halt offshore wind projects
items.summary: The RWE payout is the latest in a string of deals cancelling wind energy projects, a power source long derided by Trump.

items.title: FSSAI directs PIE FOODS to immediately stop selling two products
items.summary: India's food regulator FSSAI has ordered Pie Foods to halt sales of two sweetener products. The prohibition stems from violations of labelling and advertising regulations. FSSAI found issues with relabelling endorsements and e-commerce website operations. Mandatory declarations were missing from product labels and website claims were made.

items.title: Relief for Airtel and Vi as Supreme Court refuses stay on high court's one-time spectrum charge ruling
items.summary: The top court agreed to hear the government's appeal against the verdict quashing retrospective dues, but refused to halt the release of ₹3,300 crore in bank guarantees to the telecom operators.

items.title: Akasa Air to hire 500 pilots, add 12 planes per year over 3 years
items.summary: Akasa Air will hire over 500 pilots in the next three years. The airline plans to induct more than a dozen planes annually. International routes will increase to about forty percent of capacity. This strategy aims to improve revenue per available seat kilometre. Larger aircraft will also help reduce unit costs through economies of scale.

items.summary: Thirty-four BSE stocks doubled in six months, with 12 delivering returns of 169% to 923%. Retail investors raised stakes in several multibaggers while booking profits in others during June 2026 quarter.

items.title: Global Market: SK Hynix approves $38.3 billion investment plan through 2031 to expand AI chip production
items.summary: SK Hynix approved investments of 54.3 trillion won through 2031 to expand semiconductor production, targeting rising AI-driven demand. Funds will support new DRAM facilities in Yongin and NAND flash capacity in Cheongju. The company also plans additional shareholder return measures, with details expected during the third quarter, strengthening growth prospects.

items.summary: The company aims to double its tech unit's revenue share to over 20% by FY30 by expanding AI surveillance and payment solutions into retail, quick commerce, and EV charging.

items.title: EV retail sales break record at 3,27,901 units in July: FADA
items.summary: India's electric vehicle retail sales hit a record 3,27,901 units in July. This represents a significant 66 percent year-over-year growth for the sector. The two-wheeler segment led this surge with 2,04,362 units sold. Electric passenger and three-wheeler sales also saw substantial increases. Overall, electric vehicles now constitute nearly one in eight vehicles retailed.

The President expressed confidence in the sector's role in inclusive national development. Prestigious Sant Kabir and National Handloom Awards were also presented at the event.

items.title: Global equity funds extend inflow streak to 11 weeks as earnings optimism lifts risk appetite
items.summary: Global equity funds extended their inflow streak to 11 weeks, attracting $21.15 billion in the week ended August 5. Strong corporate earnings and easing crude prices boosted risk appetite. European and Asian equity funds led regional inflows, while emerging market equities saw their strongest weekly inflows in over five months.

items.title: India reviewing bilateral investment treaty overhaul to boost foreign investment: Official
items.summary: India is reviewing its bilateral investment treaty model soon. The cabinet will decide on changes to attract more foreign capital. This review comes as India negotiates new pacts with developed nations. Indian industry bodies also seek faster dispute resolution for investors. The nation aims to boost foreign direct investment compared to peers.

items.title: Premier Energies Q1 profit jumps 53% to ₹472 crore

items.summary: Hero MotoCorp shares surged 4.5% to ₹5,800 after a strong June-quarter, with revenues up 36% year-on-year at ₹13,126 crore. Motorcycle and scooter sales rose 23% YoY, with a notable profit increase, despite previous quarter's one-time gain. The stock has recovered 21% in five weeks.

items.title: Yen rally fades a week after U.S.-Japan intervention as focus shifts to policy
items.summary: The coordinated involvement from the Treasury and BoJ had initially lifted the yen as low as 155 to the dollar, down from just above 163 beforehand.

items.summary: SBI shares rose sharply on Friday after the lender reported a 10% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 21,121 crore, beating Street estimates. Net interest income rose 15% to Rs 46,992 crore, while total business crossed Rs 110 trillion. The stock remains 9% below its 52-week high.

items.summary: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.

items.title: RBI allows gradual device restrictions for EMI defaults, eases recovery agent disclosure norms
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will permit lenders to restrict devices bought on EMI financing. These restrictions will be gradual and only after a loan is significantly overdue. Incoming calls and emergency functions will remain accessible to borrowers. Disclosure requirements for recovery agents have also been eased by the central bank. The new rules will be implemented from January 1, 2027.

items.title: India's latest trade deals to open new global markets for Arunachal farmers, manufacturers: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: New trade deals offer Arunachal Pradesh farmers and manufacturers global market access. Nine agreements spanning thirty-eight countries create wider export opportunities for producers. These pacts aim to lower tariffs and reduce trade barriers for Indian exporters. Arunachal Pradesh's agriculture and horticulture sectors hold significant export potential. Strengthening infrastructure and market linkages will boost the state's export growth.

items.title: Indian July consumer inflation likely edged higher on food prices: Reuters poll

Many Indian states have indicated existing stocks can be sold within sixty to ninety days. Companies are also concerned about state governments seizing energy drink products. This decision is set to significantly disrupt the beverage industry in India.

items.title: Global Market: European bluechip earnings set for strongest growth since 2022 as energy sector powers profits
items.summary: European blue-chip companies are gearing up for their most promising quarterly earnings growth in the last three years, with the energy sector and basic materials industries making significant strides. The STOXX 600 index anticipates a remarkable earnings rise of 22.4 percent, alongside an uptick in revenue projections, marking the fastest sales growth seen in sixteen quarters. This overall profit resurgence is boosting investor confidence in European markets.

items.title: Delhi HC quashes criminal cases in 2015 Maggi Noodles row, sets aside summoning orders against Nestle officials
items.summary: The Delhi High Court quashed criminal complaints related to the Maggi Noodles controversy. This decision followed subsequent judicial developments and fresh testing of the product. The court found continuing prosecutions would abuse legal processes. Earlier reports formed the basis of these complaints against the company. New scientific findings significantly weakened the prosecution's original case.

items.title: SBI Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 10.2% YoY to ₹21,121 crore, NII up 15%

Speaking to CNBC, Dimon noted that AI infrastructure demand is driving US economic growth and GDP, though individual data centre project risks require careful case-by-case analysis.

items.title: Global Market: Singapore's OCBC, UOB Q2 profits rise as wealth business cushions impact of lower interest rates
items.summary: Singapore's OCBC and UOB banks have exceeded expectations with their second-quarter earnings, showcasing resilience amid lending income challenges. OCBC achieved a record quarterly net profit, while UOB surpassed analyst forecasts. The first half saw substantial growth in wealth management income, prompting both banks to declare higher interim dividends for their shareholders based on these impressive results.
